title: Rubric result
description: What one rubric pass returns for one business idea. Sent as-is to the model as the structured output format, so it uses only the JSON Schema subset structured outputs accept: no numeric ranges, no string lengths. Length limits are enforced by scripts/check.mjs (see LIMITS there).

score.description: 1 red flag, 2 weak, 3 unclear, 4 solid, 5 strong. Use the anchors in the rubric file.

confidence.description: How settled the score is: high when the text, or general knowledge that no text could change, settles it; low when it rests mostly on assumptions.

evidence.description: Up to 5 short quotes copied from the idea text or the answers. Empty when the text says nothing relevant.

assumptions.description: Up to 5 things you had to assume to score. Each starts with 'Assuming' (in Polish: 'Zakładam, że').

reasoning.description: At most 160 words. Plain sentences. Why this score and not one higher or lower; include any arithmetic the rubric asks for.

questions.description: Up to 3 questions the founder should answer to raise confidence.

improve.description: Up to 3 concrete changes to the idea that would raise the score.
